display.purpose: Page titles only; max two lines at mobile width.

headline.purpose: Panel titles and document section headings.

label.purpose: Readout labels, table headers, and status metadata.

data.purpose: Money, positions, deltas, and dates with tabular numerals.

shadows.name: primary-hover
shadows.purpose: Soft accent glow under a hovered primary button.

shadows.name: panel-none
shadows.purpose: Panels are flat at rest; depth comes from tonal shift and borders.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: All button, nav, segment, and row transitions.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: One page-level entrance; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: pulse

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single lime action voice; one per action group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #d7f36b); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--accent, #d7f36b); color: var(--accent-ink, #0c1105); font: 650 13.6px/1.2 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px color-mix(in srgb, #d7f36b 24%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d7f36b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action with a line border; fills the panel tone on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #35403a); border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft, #c6d0c9); font: 650 13.6px/1.2 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), border-color 180ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface, #101412); border-color: var(--ink-soft, #c6d0c9); color: var(--ink, #edf2ee); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d7f36b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ranking Segment
components.description: Two-option control for automatic versus adjusted ranking.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #232a26); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface, #101412); } .ds-seg-btn { padding: 6px 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #93a098); font: 650 12.8px/1.2 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms, color 180ms; } .ds-seg-btn:hover { color: var(--ink, #edf2ee); } .ds-seg-on { background: var(--accent, #d7f36b); color: var(--accent-ink, #0c1105); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Text plus dot state label; the text is the message, the colour is reinforcement.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3.5px 10px 3.5px 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #e8b45e 24%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #e8b45e 10%, transparent); color: #e8b45e; font: 600 11.5px/1.2 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { width: 6.7px; height: 6.7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat bordered surface for a work area; no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 18px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #232a26); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #101412); color: var(--ink, #edf2ee); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 700 15.2px/1.3 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0; font: 400 14px/1.6 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #93a098); }

components.name: Note Field
components.description: Review note input; dark well with a quiet focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { color: var(--muted, #93a098); font: 600 12.3px/1.4 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #35403a); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-2, #0c0f0d); color: var(--ink, #edf2ee); font: 400 14px/1.5 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; resize: vertical; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #d7f36b); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #d7f36b 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Quiet top navigation with a lime underline on the active item.
components.html: ProyectoCargaRanking
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted, #93a098); font: 600 13.6px/1.2 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms, color 180ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--surface, #101412); color: var(--ink, #edf2ee); } .ds-nav-on { background: var(--surface-2, #151a17); color: var(--ink, #edf2ee); } .ds-nav-on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 13px; right: 13px; bottom: 2px; height: 1px; background: var(--accent, #d7f36b); }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a laboratory record that happens to be interactive: a dark instrument panel for reading results, a paper-light mode for printing and daylight review, and a strict separation between what the system calculated and what a person decided. Numbers are the loudest element on the page; colour is a label, never the message. The system is deliberately quiet. Surfaces are flat and border-led, the grid is structural rather than decorative, and the only saturated gesture is a calibration-lime action. That restraint is what makes the ranking, the review and the dictamen feel like records instead of a dashboard skin.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite ground with a single lime action voice; light mode is a paper counterpart, not an afterthought.
Tabular numerals, explicit units, and absolute dates; money always reads Bs 172.800,00.
Status is a text badge with a dot; the same information survives without colour.
Rectangular panels, hairline rules, 8–12px corners; no shadowed card stack.
One authored motion: a short rise for page content and a 180ms lift on controls.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Lime appears only on the primary action, the selected segment, the focus ring, and the active nav underline. It should not exceed roughly 10% of any screen; its rarity is the signal.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Every number carries its unit and its moment. Bs 172.800,00 and 27 nov 2026, 14:31 are complete; 172800 and hoy are not.

rules.name: The Text-Not-Colour Rule
rules.body: A state is always written (Requiere revisión, Fuera del ranking); colour only reinforces it. A user who cannot see the hue must still get the answer.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any figure that sits in a column, changes after a review, or is compared with another figure uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Demo surfaces do not use a kicker above the heading; the heading carries its own weight. The legacy authentication routes keep their starter eyebrow until they are retired.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A panel at rest has no shadow. Hover may lift a control by 1px; nothing floats above the page.

dos: Do show the count of excluded proposals beside the ranking, with a link to the reason.
Do keep money, dates, and rates in explicit Spanish formats.
Do use the lime voice once per screen; let the readouts carry the hierarchy.
Do keep the dark theme as the default and preserve the light theme as a full peer.
Do use text plus colour for every state, and keep touch targets at least 44px.
donts: Don't use a decorative grid-line background; the layout grid is structure, not wallpaper.
Don't put an eyebrow above a demo page heading.
Don't use gradient text, glass, or a side accent stripe on a panel.
Don't show the model's confidence as a percentage or let it justify a discard.
Don't call the ranking definitivo, the winner ganadora, or the total TCO.
Don't use colour alone to distinguish a business rule from a technical failure.
